decisions.reason: As a homepage-level flagship aligned with the firm's cloud messaging direction in a growing market, it likely meets aspiration levels and is important enough that management would keep it.
Its dedicated page and explicit customer reference indicate visible adoption in document workflows, so management would judge it as at least near aspiration and keep it.

Its lower visibility suggests more uncertain performance, but because it builds on the core messaging and fax stack and can share resources with the established business, slack makes keeping it more likely than dropping it.
As a close optimization feature for the existing fax business, it likely has low incremental resource demands and can be retained unless results clearly fall below aspiration.
Threat protection fits the firm's regulated-customer base and strengthens the email service bundle, so management would be more likely to keep it than reallocate those resources.
